Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the director by conflating Mirage (1972), a Peruvian film clearly shown in the search results as directed by Armando Robles Godoy, with the 1965 American film Mirage directed by Edward Dmytryk. This ignored the visible evidence from IMDb/Wikipedia and led the plan briefly toward the wrong person (and thus the wrong father), reflecting a failure to corroborate and align with retrieved sources.
